comparison_note: 逐档人数、金额标签及已返回比例通过；零人数档允许省略，饼图由人数计算占比
sql: WITH customer_deposit AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(h.market_value_amount), 0) AS deposit_amount FROM dim_customer c LEFT JOIN fct_product_holding h ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND h.product_category_code = 'DEPOSIT' WHERE c.branch_id = 'B001' AND c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.customer_id ), bucketed AS ( SELECT customer_id, deposit_amount, CASE WHEN deposit_amount < 1000000 THEN '0-100万' WHEN deposit_amount < 2000000 THEN '100-200万' WHEN deposit_amount < 3000000 THEN '200-300万' WHEN deposit_amount < 4000000 THEN '300-400万' WHEN deposit_amount < 5000000 THEN '400-500万' WHEN deposit_amount < 6000000 THEN '500-600万' WHEN deposit_amount < 7000000 THEN '600-700万' WHEN deposit_amount < 8000000 THEN '700-800万' WHEN deposit_amount < 9000000 THEN '800-900万' WHEN deposit_amount <= 10000000 THEN '900-1000万' END AS deposit_band FROM customer_deposit WHERE deposit_amount BETWEEN 0 AND 10000000 ) SELECT deposit_band, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS customer_ratio_pct FROM bucketed GROUP BY deposit_band ORDER BY MIN(deposit_amount) LIMIT 100

comparison_note: 逐性别比较人数，支持常用中文标签
sql: SELECT gender_code, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM dim_customer c WHERE c.manager_id = 'M0001' AND c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY gender_code ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 100
